keyEvents.text: Goal! Fenerbahce 0, Liverpool 1. Trey Nyoni (Liverpool) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Archie Brown (Fenerbahce) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Fenerbahce 1, Liverpool 1. Mason Greenwood (Fenerbahce) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
